num_customers: <int> Total number of customers to be served over the planning horizon.
num_days: <int> Number of days in the cyclic planning horizon.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available for dispatching each day.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total delivery quantity that a single vehicle can carry on one route.
max_route_duration: <int> Maximum allowable duration for any single vehicle route.

depot.id: <int> Unique identifier for the depot location.
depot.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest departure and latest return time for vehicles at the depot.
depot.service_time: <int> Duration of service at the depot (always zero).

customers.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of the customer location.
customers.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of the customer location.
customers.demand_per_day: <int> Quantity of goods the customer requires each day.
customers.time_window: <list[float], length 2> Earliest and latest time at which service may begin at this customer.
customers.service_time: <int> Duration of the service stop at this customer.
customers.visit_frequency_original: <int> Number of visits this customer requires per planning horizon.

schedules.days: <list[int], length visit_frequency> Days within the planning horizon on which the customer is visited under this schedule.
schedules.visit_frequency: <int> Number of visits in this schedule over the planning horizon.

parts.visit_day: <int> Day on which this delivery visit occurs.
parts.days_covered: <int> Number of consecutive demand-days supplied by this single delivery.
parts.demand_per_visit: <int> Total quantity to be delivered on this visit.

distance_matrix_type: <str> Method used to compute distances between all location pairs.
cost_type: <str> Method used to compute the travel cost between locations.
planning_horizon_cyclic: <bool> Whether the last day of the planning horizon wraps around to the first day.
